claims.statement: Tom Allen's place at 619 Market street advertised a free concert and the best boxing in the city every evening.
claims.excerpt: Free concert and best boxing in the city every evening.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was advertised as the retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, 619 Market street.

notes: Other items (base ball, the river find, the amateur games) are not about Allen.
